title: Founder Security: Identity & Domains

freshness.note: options reused from founder-security-founder-and-app-security (split, not new)

pairs.ask: Research Founder Security: SIM-swap protection, turn on your Carrier's number lock and port-out PIN this week, or later, (fcc.gov SIM swap rules 2023).

optionA.label: Turn On This Week
optionA.desc: Stops someone moving your number to their SIM to grab codes.

optionB.label: Later
optionB.desc: Leaves the phone number open to port-out fraud.

pairs.ask_old: SIM-Swap Protection: Turn On Your Carrier's Number Lock And Port-Out PIN This Week, Or Later? (fcc.gov SIM swap rules 2023)

pairs.ask: Phone Number As Account Recovery: Remove It From Google, GitHub And Stripe Recovery, Or Keep It As A Backup?

optionA.label: Remove The Phone Number
optionA.desc: A swapped SIM can no longer reset your accounts.

optionB.label: Keep As Backup
optionB.desc: Easier recovery, but the number becomes a weak spot.

pairs.ask: Research Founder Security: Google Advanced protection Program for your main email, Enroll, or standard Security, (landing.google.com/advancedprotection).

optionA.label: Enroll
optionA.desc: Strongest Google account protection; needs passkeys or keys.

optionB.label: Standard Security
optionB.desc: Fewer limits on apps and recovery.

pairs.ask_old: Google Advanced Protection Program For Your Main Email: Enroll, Or Standard Security? (landing.google.com/advancedprotection)

pairs.ask: Research Founder Security: Identity, admin email for registrar, Stripe and GitHub: a separate Unpublished address, or your public email?

optionA.label: Separate Unpublished Address
optionA.desc: Attackers cannot target an address they never see.

optionB.label: Public Email
optionB.desc: One inbox; also the one phishers know.

pairs.ask_old: Admin Email For Registrar, Stripe And GitHub: A Separate Unpublished Address, Or Your Public Email?

pairs.ask: Research Founder Security: Domains, domain registrar lock (transfer lock) on maxweberman.com and smartupkeep.ai: confirm it is on, or leave default, (icann.org transfer lock).

optionA.label: Confirm Lock Is On
optionA.desc: Blocks unauthorized transfers away from your registrar.

pairs.ask_old: Domain Registrar Lock (Transfer Lock) On maxweberman.com And smartupkeep.ai: Confirm It Is On, Or Leave Default? (icann.org transfer lock)

pairs.ask: Research Board: Domain auto-renew plus a backup card and expiry alerts, set up, or renew Manually?

optionA.label: Auto-Renew With Backup Card
optionA.desc: Lapsed domains get grabbed and used for phishing.

pairs.ask_old: Domain Auto-Renew Plus A Backup Card And Expiry Alerts: Set Up, Or Renew Manually?

pairs.ask: Research Founder Security: CAA DNS records, limit which companies can issue certificates for your domains, or Allow any, (RFC 8659).

optionA.label: Add CAA Records
optionA.desc: Only your chosen certificate issuers can make certs for your sites.

optionB.label: Allow Any
optionB.desc: Default; any certificate authority can issue.

pairs.ask_old: CAA DNS Records: Limit Which Companies Can Issue Certificates For Your Domains, Or Allow Any? (RFC 8659)

pairs.ask: Research Founder Security: Email Spoofing, publish SPF, DKIM and DMARC (p=reject) for your domains, or leave it, (Google sender guidelines).

optionA.label: Set Up DMARC Reject
optionA.desc: Stops others sending email that looks like it is from you.

optionB.label: Leave It
optionB.desc: Your domain can be spoofed to customers.

pairs.ask_old: Email Spoofing: Publish SPF, DKIM And DMARC (p=reject) For Your Domains, Or Leave It? (Google sender guidelines)

pairs.ask: Contractor Offboarding: Same-Day Checklist To Remove GitHub, Drive, Dropbox And Tool Access, Or Ad Hoc?

optionA.label: Same-Day Checklist
optionA.desc: Ex-helpers lose access the day work ends.

optionB.label: Ad Hoc
optionB.desc: Old access tends to linger for months.

pairs.ask: Shared Logins: One Seat Per Person (Or Shared Vault Items), Or Share Passwords In Chat?

optionA.label: One Seat Or Vault Sharing
optionA.desc: You can remove one person without changing everyone's password.

optionB.label: Share In Chat
optionB.desc: Passwords live forever in chat history.
